title: lightdni-jssas-toggle
description: lightdni (Doesn't Need Integration) provides a simple declarative API for adding a theme toggle to your website.

content.heading: lightdni-jssas-toggle - the theme toggle, no integration needed
content: **lightdni** (Doesn't Need Integration) provides a simple declarative API for adding a theme toggle to your website.

content.heading: how a website wears its theme
content: a website's theme is conventionally worn on the root element: a class or a data attribute selects the palette, CSS variables carry the colors, and persistence rides localStorage or a cookie. the platform adds the rest - `color-scheme` for the browser's own widgets, `prefers-color-scheme` for the system setting.
every framework re-implements this wiring. **lightdni** is that wiring, once, declaratively - in vanilla JS/TS, React and Vue projects alike.

content.heading: the package, architecturally
content: a TypeScript utility package: one consolidated `setTheme` call that applies theme classes and attributes on the root element, resolves dynamic CSS variables, persists through localStorage/cookie, and maintains the accessibility metadata (`color-scheme`, `aria-live` announcements).
dependency-safe - no framework runtime, no peer installs.

content.heading: quirks
content: the persisted theme name is read back defensively - a stored value that names no known theme resolves to the default, not to a broken palette.

content.heading: stable in v1.x
content: the one-call `setTheme` API is the stable surface; the persisted-theme reader is back with tests.
